name: Effort-Scoped Review Budget
goal: Bind the one-blind-plan-review budget to the operator-initiated effort (not the auto plan_lineage), so a retreat cannot mint a fresh blind review, while a changed plan proceeds via advisor-remediation and a new effort still earns its one review.

tasks.name: Effort-scoped lineage increment (MCP-transition set-site)
tasks.description: Add exported helper inheritReviewOnDesignReentry(from) and apply it in executeWorkflowTransition when target is brainstorming OR debugging (idle/execution_complete -> {inherit_review:0}; RETREAT_SOURCES[from] -> {inherit_review:1}; else {}). Gate the plan_lineage increment in mark_design_ready + consumeDesign on inherit_review === 0. Fix the idempotency test's hand-built schema to add the column. TDD: retreat inherits, new-effort increments, mark_brainstorming-from-executing inherits, mid-effort->debugging->brainstorming inherits (C2 two-hop), execution_complete->brainstorming->debugging->brainstorming increments.

steps.description: Create effort-scoped-review-budget.test.ts using initDb(':memory:') (real schema). Cases: (a) retreat executing->brainstorming then mark_design_ready keeps plan_lineage unchanged; (b) execution_complete->brainstorming then mark_design_ready increments; (c) mark_brainstorming from executing sets inherit_review=1 (next mark_design_ready no increment); (d) mark_debugging from executing then debugging->brainstorming then mark_design_ready keeps plan_lineage unchanged (two-hop); (e) execution_complete->brainstorming->debugging->brainstorming then mark_design_ready increments.
steps.expected: FAIL: current code increments on every brainstorming->design_ready and never sets inherit_review; (a),(c),(d) fail.

steps.description: In state-machine.ts add exported inheritReviewOnDesignReentry(from): idle/execution_complete -> {inherit_review:0}; RETREAT_SOURCES[from] -> {inherit_review:1}; else {}. In executeWorkflowTransition after artifactFields, add designReentryFields = (target==='brainstorming' || target==='debugging') ? inheritReviewOnDesignReentry(from) : {}; spread into updateSession before workflow_stage.
steps.expected: design-phase entry sets inherit_review from FROM-stage for both brainstorming and debugging targets

tasks.name: skill-state-bridge.sh set-site (C2b dominant live path)
tasks.description: The brainstorming/systematic-debugging skill invocation fires skill-state-bridge.sh, which raw-UPDATEs workflow_stage from any stage BEFORE the skill runs (making the later mark_brainstorming a no-op) — bypassing the executeWorkflowTransition flag. Append an inherit_review assignment computed from CURRENT_STAGE to the hook UPDATES for the brainstorming and systematic-debugging cases. TDD: a hook test.

steps.description: Create test-skill-state-bridge-inherit-review.sh mirroring an existing hook test (e.g. test-session-init-plan-lineage.sh): init a temp DB with the real sessions schema, seed a session, set workflow_stage='executing', pipe a Skill/brainstorming invocation into skill-state-bridge.sh, assert inherit_review=1; second case workflow_stage='execution_complete' -> brainstorming -> inherit_review=0.
steps.expected: FAIL: the hook does not yet write inherit_review; the =1 assertion fails.

steps.description: In skill-state-bridge.sh, after the case block (sets UPDATES/STAGE_CHANGE) and before the idempotent-exit check, add: TARGET_FOR_BUDGET=${STAGE_CHANGE#workflow_stage=}; if TARGET_FOR_BUDGET is brainstorming or debugging, case CURRENT_STAGE: idle|execution_complete -> UPDATES="${UPDATES}, inherit_review=0"; the 8 RETREAT_SOURCES stages -> UPDATES="${UPDATES}, inherit_review=1"; else leave unchanged.
steps.expected: hook appends inherit_review from CURRENT_STAGE for brainstorming/debugging targets
